newsitem.title: GABON: Gabon mini-summit will discuss future Zaire talks.
newsitem.headline: Gabon mini-summit will discuss future Zaire talks.

text.p: A mini-summit in the Gabonese capital attended by embattled Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko will discuss future talks between him and rebel leader Laurent Kabila, a Gabonese official said on Wednesday.
The spokesman for the Gabonese president's office, Vincent Mavungu, told journalists that a meeting of Central African leaders would begin at 11 a.m. (1000 GMT) on Thursday.
Mavungu said future talks between Mobutu and Kabila would be a follow-up to a ship-borne meeting hosted by South African President Nelson Mandela.
Those talks were inconclusive and South Africa said the civil war foes had agreed to meet again within 10 days.
Despite assurances from Mobutu's aides that he would return, his departure from the Zaire capital Kinshasa on Wednesday sparked rumours that he had left for good.
Residents of a rebel-held town 200 km (125 miles) east of the capital report heavy fighting and hundreds of dead as Kabila's forces fight loyalist Mobutu troops on a road leading to the city.
